marker_rule: A marker is placed ONLY at the published seat of an institution the incident report itself names as acted upon. The marker means: 'this named institution is where the reported action landed' — never where an AI system was located, and never a location the source did not name. The card states the institution, what the source reported, the incident date as dated by the source, the report date, and the source. Where a source names no institution (an unnamed website, an unnamed university), there is NO marker — the rule working visibly. Coordinates are the institution's public seat, city precision.
